description: Descope brings a first-class authentication and identity management experience into ChatGPT. Manage users, tenants, roles, and access control across your Descope projects through natural language. Build and modify auth flows for signup, login, MFA, SSO, and federation without leaving the conversation. Configure auth, consent, and credential management for your MCP servers and AI agents, and easily search Descope documentation when you need guidance.
